preserveReasons.Gil_Rating_50: Player-facing reaction contains only the runtime rating placeholder, punctuation and an emotion marker, so it must remain byte-exact.

corrections: Translated all sixteen Gil rating and makeover strings directly from English while preserving both rating placeholders, dialogue and emotion markers, punctuation-only reaction and the intentional trailing space.
Applied locked Ръждив меч and Гилдия на приключенците terminology and retained the established Яйце Калико rendering in the event title.
Reread the full reward sequence and stylist variants for register and natural Bulgarian; replaced literal attendant wording and refined the two return-visit lines.
